'''Annor Fash''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Chirq Council]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] who lived on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Annor Fash was one of the three individuals who ran the [[Kor Vella/Legends|Kor Vella]] chapter of the Chirq Council, also known as the Red Circle Gang, along with [[Vora Anjek]] and [[Vella Corse]]. He was based in the [[Red Circle Base]], a bunker in the [[Vella plains]].<ref name="SWG:CCFTUM" />
[[File:Red_Circle_Bunker.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The Red Circle Base]]
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> the [[Corellian Security Force]] started an investigation against the Red Circle Gang following the increase of spice traffic in Kor Vella. A [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] working for [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Lon Cope|Cope]] discovered the existence of the [[Ryll/Legends|ryll]] smuggling ring of the Red Circle Gang and the location of the [[Ryll Smuggler Base]].<ref name="SWG:CCFRSR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|CorSec Case Files: Ryll Smuggling Ring|Corellia}}</ref> After the assassination of the [[Mayor/Legends|mayor]] of Kor Vella [[Deel Draav]] by the Red Circle Gang, the CorSec raided the Ryll Smuggler Base. The spacer eliminated the underboss [[Ubis Reendorr]] and retrieved his access code for the Red Circle Base. The CorSec later assaulted the Red Circle Base nearby and killed most of the guards. The spacer used Reendorr's access code to slice the mainframe in the courtyard of the base and learned the identity of the three local Chirq Council leaders: Annor Fash, Vora Anjek and Vella Corse. The CorSec therefore attacked the basement of the Red Circle Base and killed the three leaders. During the assault, the spacer also discovered that the [[Elite Council|leaders]] of the Chirq Council were based in the city [[Doaba Guerfel/Legends|Doaba Guerfel]].<ref name="SWG:CCFTUM" /> The CorSec investigation eventually led to the disbandment of the Chirq Council.<ref name="SWG:TCCTEC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|The Chirq Council: The Elite Council|Corellia}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Annor Fash was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:CCFTUM" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Annor Fash was added to the game with the update named "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives, Publish Notes, June 8th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=48548|text="Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives", Publish Notes, June 8th}}</ref>
